title: Loop template usage
responsibility: Summarizes loop counts, completion and recent names by template.

inputs.name: loopUsage.loops
inputs.description: Loop states containing optional template, steps, update time and name; missing template is grouped as custom.

outputs.name: loopUsage
outputs.description: Total loop count and per-template usage sorted by descending count then template name. Completion requires at least one step and every step complete; each group includes its latest update and up to five recent names.
